The structure of Ca8As4Pb4O24 (reduced formula Ca2AsPbO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Im-3 (No. 119), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As and Pb each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Ca adopts a close-packed-like 12-fold O environment. Corner-sharing between As- and Pb-centered octahedra and face-sharing between Ca and Pb polyhedra are observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
